verdict.rationale: Attio documents ways to issue API credentials: an OAuth flow for apps that use its REST API, and an ATTIO_API_TOKEN available to app server functions. Nothing in the evidence shows that these credentials can be limited by scope, read/write permission or object, which is the heart of the story. missing for 10: documented API token scopes or permission levels, per-agent or least-privilege credential configuration, OAuth scope definitions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
